idea-plugin.name: Branch Changes
idea-plugin.description: Highlights added, modified, and deleted editor lines against an explicitly selected branch base. Choose a continuously recomputed Fork point or compare directly with the locally known Branch HEAD. Includes committed, staged, unstaged, and unsaved changes, supports Git-detected committed/staged renames, and opens baseline-to-live full-file diffs from gutter markers. Base and mode mappings stay workspace-local; Git operations remain local, read-only, and never fetch.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Adds IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 compatibility and removes the upper IDE version limit. IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3 remains the minimum; future versions are allowed on a best-effort basis. Git behavior remains local-only, read-only, and no-fetch.
